original_title: The French Historical Revolution: The Annales School, 1929–89
note: Portuguese translation under a shortened citation title. Candidate is a later English edition; original publication was 1990, not the candidate record’s 2015.

original_title: La culture politique
container: Jean-Pierre Rioux and Jean-François Sirinelli (eds.), Pour une histoire culturelle, Paris: Seuil, 1997, pp. 371–386.
note: Portuguese translation of Berstein’s chapter in Para uma história cultural (1998). ISBN identifies the original container. Neither the 1992 article L’historien et la culture politique nor Les cultures politiques en France is this chapter.

original_title: Pour une histoire culturelle
note: Portuguese translation of the collection edited by Jean-Pierre Rioux and Jean-François Sirinelli. Author field conflates contributor Berstein with the editors and truncates Rioux’s name. Distinct from Histoire culturelle de la France and the listed Sirinelli articles; no candidate matches the whole book.

id: W:cuche|nocao de cultura nas ciencias sociais
original_title: La notion de culture dans les sciences sociales
note: Portuguese translation of Cuche’s French book, first published by La Découverte in 1996. Original ISBN confirmed in the library catalogue; no candidates supplied.

id: W:bruneau|catolicismo brasileiro em epoca de transicao
original_title: The Political Transformation of the Brazilian Catholic Church
note: Portuguese edition of the 1974 English book. The identification is also explicitly confirmed in the Notre Dame Kellogg working paper The Church and the Abertura in Brazil; not Bruneau’s later The Church in Brazil.

original_title: Introdução à análise do discurso
note: Brandão’s own book; 2004 is its revised second edition. Publisher front matter confirms first edition 1991 and second edition 2004. ISBN belongs to the original edition family and is confirmed in UESC’s library inventory; no candidates supplied.

original_title: The Jazz Scene
note: Portuguese translation of the book originally published in 1959 under Hobsbawm’s pseudonym Francis Newton. Candidate is the revised 1993 English edition of the same work; distinct from Uncommon People.

original_title: Convite à filosofia
note: Chauí’s introductory philosophy textbook, first published in 1994. Catalogue confirms the cited 2000 twelfth edition and its ISBN. None of the listed works is this book.

original_title: Nem pátria, nem patrão!: vida operária e cultura anarquista no Brasil
note: Hardman’s book, first published by Brasiliense in 1983; 2002 is the revised and enlarged third edition, subtitled Memória operária, cultura e literatura no Brasil. Author field has an unrelated Hardman title appended; the cited title itself is identifiable. OCLC identifies the original edition.

original_title: How Societies Remember
note: Portuguese translation of Connerton’s 1989 book, published by Celta in 1993; matches the original English candidate.

original_title: Государство и революция: учение марксизма о государстве и задачи пролетариата в революции
note: Lenin’s The State and Revolution, written in 1917 and first published in Russian in 1918 (confirmed by the Russian State Public Historical Library, elib.shpl.ru/ru/nodes/91873). No candidates supplied. OCLC identifies an early English translation catalogued as [1918], not the cited Portuguese printing.

original_title: Come si fa una tesi di laurea: le materie umanistiche
note: Portuguese translation of Eco’s 1977 Italian manual. UFSC’s translation bibliography explicitly identifies it as an integral translation of this original; matches the Italian candidate rather than the 2015 English translation.

original_title: Ἱστορίαι (History of the Peloponnesian War)
note: Thucydides’ ancient history, translated from Greek by Mário da Gama Kury. Publisher confirms the 2001 Portuguese edition and ISBN. Composition spans the late fifth/early fourth century BCE; no single original publication year is assigned. No candidates supplied.

original_title: História das mulheres
container: Ciro Flamarion Cardoso and Ronaldo Vainfas (eds.), Domínios da história: ensaios de teoria e metodologia, Rio de Janeiro: Campus, 1997, pp. 275–296.
note: Soihet’s chapter in Domínios da história, not an independent book or her edited Ensino de história. ISBN identifies the original container, confirmed in Biblioteca Dom Alberto’s catalogue; chapter pagination is corroborated by university bibliographies.

original_title: O pacto autobiográfico: de Rousseau à internet
note: Brazilian selection organized by Jovita Maria Gerheim Noronha, translating French essays spanning more than thirty years. It is not the complete 1975 Le pacte autobiographique or the different English selection On Autobiography. Author bibliography confirms the 2008 selection; an identifier for this edition was not verified in a library catalogue or publisher record.

original_title: Tristes tropiques
note: Portuguese translation of Lévi-Strauss’s 1955 book; matches the original French candidate.

original_title: Democracy against Capitalism: Renewing Historical Materialism
note: Portuguese translation of Wood’s 1995 book; matches w-588 despite that candidate’s truncated title.

original_title: A belle époque amazônica
note: Ana Maria Daou’s book in the Descobrindo o Brasil series. Publisher dates first release 1 November 1999; IUCAT catalogues the cited edition as 2000 (iucat.iu.edu/iub/4761950). ISBN confirmed by publisher; no candidates supplied.

id: W:baena|ensaio corografico sobre a provincia do para
original_title: Ensaio corografico sobre a provincia do Pará
note: Baena’s geographical and historical description, first published at Pará by Typ. de Santos & menor in 1839. The cited 2004 Senate reprint is confirmed by the publisher’s catalogue. No candidates supplied; no LCCN, ISBN or OCLC number was verified. Institutional catalogue identifier: bbm/7185.

original_title: Histoire de la vie privée, tome 4: De la Révolution à la Grande Guerre
note: Most likely the fourth volume, edited by Michelle Perrot, in its 2009 Portuguese pocket edition. Publisher preview confirms original title and 1987 copyright. Citation omits volume/subtitle, so identification remains qualified. ISBN identifies that Portuguese volume. None of Perrot’s listed candidates is this book.
